caption:
Stop spending an hour a week stitching together promo videos for your services. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash now generates fifteen second clips directly in the chat. You can draft a quick product demo or service explainer without leaving your research tab. The tool handles pacing and scene cuts automatically, but it still struggles with complex camera movements and exact text rendering.

Paste this prompt into your Gemini chat window to test it:
Generate a fifteen second video showing a freelancer working at a clean desk, reviewing a client contract on a tablet, then smiling at the camera. Use a bright office setting with natural lighting. Keep the pacing steady and avoid fast cuts.

This runs on the Gemini API and Google Cloud business accounts. Pricing is roughly $0.07 per second for 720p output, which cuts your weekly video costs by about thirty percent compared to the previous model. Edit the clip by replying to the chat if the lighting or pacing needs adjusting.
